procedure: Common fixed hyper-parameters (config.LC_PARAMS, chosen by CV on the seed alone) for every arm and realization; conclusions are conditional on the seed, the test sets and these hyper-parameters. r0 = the existing sets (exploratory, reported apart); r1.. = new realizations (confirmatory). Independent arms: Welch interval; arms sharing points within a realization: paired interval. P(first<second) is descriptive (the pairs are not independent): for Welch comparisons it is taken over all n x n realization pairs and, for paired comparisons, over the n within-realization pairs; ties count 1/2 in both. Scales: log-RMSE (absolute) and log(log-RMSE) (relative). An interval containing 0 is inconclusive, not a tie. These intervals cover variability between designs only. Because both test sets are held fixed, test-sampling error is a component common to every realization: it does not widen the spread between them and does not average out over them. It is covered separately by the paired bootstrap of `sgs evaluate`, and the two components are never combined. The oracle block (C-oracle against C-logP, confirmatory realizations only, no r0) follows the readings declared in docs/oracle-declaration.md before the pool was solved; 'attributable to the screener's error, in this design' is used only where the paired dR_O interval excludes 0, on the side of the reading, in at least three of four cells.
